name: Descript OG social card by descript.com
description: A 1200×630 social card staged on a single deep-burgundy field with no gradient or texture. The top third holds a three-line, sentence-case serif headline in cream with tight leading and terminal periods; the centre is a white product screenshot flanked by video-still strips that bleed off both canvas edges like a timeline, one small circular avatar overlapping on the right. The rhythm runs quiet–busy–quiet, with colour rationed to the burgundy stage, cream type, and a single red accent reserved for the logo mark above the lowercase sans wordmark.
